risk_factors.title: Risk Factors
risk_factors.content:
RISK FACTORS

Investment in equity shares involves a degree of risk. Investors should carefully read all risk factors 
before taking an investment decision. Additional risks not currently known may also materially impair 
the Company's business, financial condition, and results of operations.

**1. Limited Operating History Risk**
Test Pharma Ltd was incorporated on 2018-01-15. Our limited operating history makes it difficult to assess future performance.

**2. Sector-Specific Competition Risk**
The Pharmaceuticals sector is highly competitive. We face competition from larger, better-capitalised entities with greater market reach.

**3. Working Capital Risk**
Our business requires continuous working capital deployment. Delays in receivables or unforeseen capital requirements may impact liquidity.

**4. Key Personnel Risk**
Our success depends on senior management retention. Loss of key personnel may adversely affect our business.

**5. Regulatory Compliance Risk**
Our Pharmaceuticals business is subject to central and state government regulations. Changes in applicable laws could adversely impact operations.

**6. No Prior Public Market Risk**
There is no prior public market for our equity shares. The Issue price may not be indicative of the post-listing trading price.

**7. Promoter Lock-in Risk**
Promoter shares are subject to SEBI-mandated lock-in for 3 years. Post lock-in exit by promoters may create downward price pressure.

**8. General Economic Risk**
Our financial performance is linked to overall economic conditions in India and globally. Economic 
downturns, inflationary pressures, interest rate changes, and foreign exchange fluctuations could 
adversely affect our business.

**9. Geopolitical and Force Majeure Risk**
Unforeseen events including natural disasters, pandemics, geopolitical tensions, and social unrest 
could disrupt supply chains, reduce consumer demand, and adversely impact results.

Note: The above risk factors are based on information provided and general sector knowledge. 
Company-specific risk factors based on uploaded documents and detailed business information 
should be added by the legal team and merchant banker before filing.

business_overview.title: Business Overview
business_overview.content:
**BUSINESS OVERVIEW**

**Introduction**

Test Pharma Ltd, a company incorporated on January 15, 2018, under the Companies Act, 2013, with its registered office at 123 MG Road, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400001, is a generic pharmaceutical manufacturer producing quality medicines for the domestic and export markets. Our company has over 6 years of operating history and serves hospitals, distributors, and retail chemists across 10 Indian states.

**Business Description**

We are engaged in the manufacture of generic pharmaceutical products, including tablets, capsules, and syrups. Our products cater to the needs of various therapeutic segments, and we have established a strong presence in the domestic market. Our manufacturing facilities are equipped with modern infrastructure and technology, enabling us to produce high-quality products that meet international standards.

**Key Products/Services**

Our key products include generic tablets, capsules, and syrups, which are manufactured at our facilities and marketed through our distribution network. We have a strong product portfolio, with a focus on quality and affordability.

**Geographical Presence**

We have a significant presence in the states of Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Rajasthan, with plans to expand our reach to other parts of the country. Our products are marketed through a network of distributors and retail chemists, ensuring widespread availability and accessibility.

**Certifications and Compliance**

We have obtained the ISO 9001:2015 certification, which demonstrates our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. We are also compliant with all applicable regulatory requirements, including those related to manufacturing, quality control, and environmental protection.

**Promoters and Management**

Our promoters, Ramesh Kumar and Sunita Kumar, have extensive experience in the pharmaceutical industry and have played a key role in shaping the company's strategy and direction. Ramesh Kumar, our Managing Director, holds 55.0% of the company's equity, while Sunita Kumar, our Director, holds 15.0%.

**Financial Performance**

Our financial performance over the past three years is as follows:

| Year | Revenue (INR Lakhs) | PAT (INR Lakhs) | EBITDA (INR Lakhs) | Total Assets (INR Lakhs) | Equity (INR Lakhs) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2021-22 | 1,200.50 | 85.30 | 142.00 | 950.20 | 420.10 |
| 2022-23 | 1,480.80 | 110.20 | 178.40 | 1,120.50 | 530.30 |
| 2023-24 | 1,820.30 | 142.70 | 220.50 | 1,350.80 | 660.00 |

**Issue Details**

We are proposing to issue [MISSING: number] equity shares of face value ₹10 each, with a price band of ₹90 to ₹95 per share. The issue size is ₹25.00 Crore, comprising a fresh issue of ₹20.00 Crore and an offer for sale of ₹5.00 Crore. The objects of the issue are:

1. Expansion of manufacturing capacity at our Pune plant: ₹12.00 Crore
2. Working capital requirements: ₹5.00 Crore
3. General corporate purposes: ₹3.00 Crore

Our lead manager for the issue is XYZ Capital Advisors Pvt Ltd.

**Reservation in Issue**

As per SEBI ICDR Regulations, at least 50% of the net offer is reserved for retail individual investors, while the remaining net offer is available to non-institutional investors and qualified institutional buyers (QIBs). A specified portion is reserved for market makers.

**Statutory Auditor**

Our statutory auditor is ABC & Co. Chartered Accountants.

**Website**

Our website is [https://testpharma.com](https://testpharma.com), which provides information about our company, products, and services.

**Employees**

We have a team of 350 employees, who are dedicated to our mission of providing quality pharmaceutical products to our customers.

By filing this draft red herring prospectus through SEBI's PRISM system, we are complying with the regulatory requirements for SME IPOs. Our financial data is also being filed in XBRL format, as required by the SEBI regulations.

industry_overview.content:
## Industry Overview

The Indian pharmaceutical industry has experienced significant growth over the years, driven by an increasing demand for quality and affordable healthcare services. As a key player in this sector, Test Pharma Ltd operates in the generic drugs sub-sector, which has been a major contributor to the industry's growth.

### Introduction to the Indian Pharmaceutical Sector

The Indian pharmaceutical sector is one of the largest and most developed in the world. It has been a significant contributor to the country's economy, with a large number of domestic and international players operating in the market. The sector has been driven by factors such as a large and growing patient population, an increasing demand for healthcare services, and a strong presence of pharmaceutical manufacturers.

### Generic Drugs Sub-Sector

The generic drugs sub-sector has been a major driver of growth in the Indian pharmaceutical sector. Generic drugs are pharmaceutical products that are equivalent to brand-name products in terms of quality, strength, and efficacy, but are available at a lower cost. The generic drugs sub-sector has been driven by factors such as the increasing demand for affordable healthcare services, the expiration of patents for several blockbuster drugs, and the growing presence of generic drug manufacturers.

### Market Trends and Outlook

The Indian pharmaceutical sector is expected to continue growing in the coming years, driven by factors such as the increasing demand for healthcare services, the growing presence of pharmaceutical manufacturers, and the government's initiatives to promote the sector. The generic drugs sub-sector is also expected to continue growing, driven by the increasing demand for affordable healthcare services and the expiration of patents for several blockbuster drugs.

### Competitive Landscape

The Indian pharmaceutical sector is highly competitive, with a large number of domestic and international players operating in the market. The sector is characterized by a high level of competition, with companies competing on factors such as price, quality, and innovation. Test Pharma Ltd operates in this competitive landscape, with a focus on producing high-quality generic drugs at affordable prices.

### Regulatory Environment

The Indian pharmaceutical sector is regulated by several regulatory bodies, including the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) and the State Drug Authorities. The sector is subject to several regulations, including the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, and the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945. Test Pharma Ltd is required to comply with these regulations, and has obtained the necessary certifications, including ISO 9001:2015, to ensure the quality of its products.

### Company's Position in the Industry

Test Pharma Ltd is a generic pharmaceutical manufacturer that operates in the domestic and export markets. The company has a strong presence in the Indian market, with a network of distributors and retail chemists across 10 Indian states. The company's products include generic tablets, capsules, and syrups, which are manufactured at its facilities in Maharashtra. With a team of 350 employees, the company is well-positioned to take advantage of the growing demand for generic drugs in the Indian market.

### Growth Drivers

The growth of the Indian pharmaceutical sector is driven by several factors, including:

* Increasing demand for healthcare services
* Growing presence of pharmaceutical manufacturers
* Government initiatives to promote the sector
* Expiration of patents for several blockbuster drugs
* Increasing demand for affordable healthcare services

These factors are expected to continue driving the growth of the sector in the coming years, and Test Pharma Ltd is well-positioned to take advantage of these trends.

### Risks and Challenges

The Indian pharmaceutical sector is subject to several risks and challenges, including:

* Intense competition
* Regulatory risks
* Quality control risks
* Supply chain risks
* Pricing pressures

Test Pharma Ltd is required to manage these risks and challenges, and has implemented several measures to mitigate them, including a strong quality control system and a robust supply chain management system.

In terms of the company's financial performance, the following information is available:
* Revenue: ₹1,200.50L (2021-22), ₹1,480.80L (2022-23), ₹1,820.30L (2023-24)
* Profit After Tax (PAT): ₹85.30L (2021-22), ₹110.20L (2022-23), ₹142.70L (2023-24)
* Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA): ₹142.00L (2021-22), ₹178.40L (2022-23), ₹220.50L (2023-24)

Overall, the Indian pharmaceutical sector is expected to continue growing in the coming years, driven by several factors, including the increasing demand for healthcare services and the growing presence of pharmaceutical manufacturers. Test Pharma Ltd is well-positioned to take advantage of these trends, with a strong presence in the domestic and export markets, and a focus on producing high-quality generic drugs at affordable prices.

mda.title: Management Discussion and Analysis
mda.content:
**Management Discussion and Analysis**

**Introduction**

Test Pharma Ltd (the "Company") is a generic pharmaceutical manufacturer producing quality medicines for the domestic and export markets. The Company has over 6 years of operating history and serves hospitals, distributors, and retail chemists across 10 Indian states. This Management Discussion and Analysis ("MD&A") section provides an overview of the Company's financial performance, business operations, and future outlook.

**Financial Performance**

The Company's financial performance for the last three fiscal years is as follows:

| Year | Revenue (INR Lakhs) | Profit After Tax (INR Lakhs) | EBITDA (INR Lakhs) | Total Assets (INR Lakhs) | Equity (INR Lakhs) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2021-22 | 1,200.50 | 85.30 | 142.00 | 950.20 | 420.10 |
| 2022-23 | 1,480.80 | 110.20 | 178.40 | 1,120.50 | 530.30 |
| 2023-24 | 1,820.30 | 142.70 | 220.50 | 1,350.80 | 660.00 |

The Company's revenue has consistently increased over the last three fiscal years, with a growth rate of [MISSING: revenue growth rate calculation]. The Company's profit after tax has also increased, with a growth rate of [MISSING: profit after tax growth rate calculation]. The Company's EBITDA margin has remained stable, indicating efficient operations.

**Business Operations**

The Company's business operations are focused on the manufacture and sale of generic pharmaceutical products, including tablets, capsules, and syrups. The Company's products are sold to hospitals, distributors, and retail chemists across 10 Indian states, with a significant presence in Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Rajasthan. The Company has obtained ISO 9001:2015 certification, demonstrating its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

**Industry Overview**

The Indian pharmaceutical industry is highly competitive, with a large number of players operating in the market. The industry is subject to various regulatory requirements, including those related to product approvals, pricing, and quality control. The Company faces competition from established players, as well as new entrants in the market. Despite these challenges, the Company has been able to maintain its market share and grow its revenue over the last three fiscal years.

**Future Outlook**

The Company's future outlook is positive, with plans to expand its manufacturing capacity at the Pune plant and increase its presence in the domestic and export markets. The Company intends to use the proceeds from the issue to achieve the following objects:

1. Expansion of manufacturing capacity at Pune Plant: Rs. 12 Crore
2. Working capital requirements: Rs. 5 Crore
3. General corporate purposes: Rs. 3 Crore

The Company believes that these initiatives will enable it to increase its revenue and profitability, and achieve its growth objectives.

**Risk Factors**

The Company is subject to various risks and uncertainties, including those related to regulatory requirements, competition, and market conditions. The Company's ability to achieve its growth objectives is dependent on its ability to manage these risks and uncertainties. The Company's risk management policies and procedures are designed to identify, assess, and mitigate these risks.

**Internal Control Systems**

The Company has established internal control systems to ensure the accuracy and reliability of its financial reporting and to prevent fraud and error. The Company's internal control systems include policies and procedures related to financial reporting, accounting, and auditing. The Company's statutory auditor, ABC & Co. Chartered Accountants, has reviewed the Company's internal control systems and has provided a report on the same.

**Conclusion**

In conclusion, the Company's financial performance, business operations, and future outlook are positive. The Company has consistently increased its revenue and profitability over the last three fiscal years, and has plans to expand its manufacturing capacity and increase its presence in the domestic and export markets. The Company is subject to various risks and uncertainties, but has established internal control systems to manage these risks and ensure the accuracy and reliability of its financial reporting.

objects_of_issue.content:
## Objects of the Issue

The Net Proceeds from the Fresh Issue of ₹20.00 Crore, after deducting the Issue related expenses, are proposed to be utilized by Test Pharma Ltd in the following manner:

### 1. Expansion of Manufacturing Capacity at Pune Plant
The Company proposes to utilize ₹12.00 Crore towards the expansion of its manufacturing capacity at the Pune Plant. This expansion is expected to enhance the production capabilities of the Company, enabling it to cater to the growing demand for its products in the domestic and export markets.

### 2. Working Capital Requirements
The Company intends to allocate ₹5.00 Crore towards working capital requirements. This allocation will enable the Company to efficiently manage its day-to-day operations, including the procurement of raw materials, payment to suppliers, and meeting other operational expenses.

### 3. General Corporate Purposes
The Company plans to utilize ₹3.00 Crore for general corporate purposes. This will provide the Company with the flexibility to meet any unforeseen expenses or to capitalize on new business opportunities that may arise.

### Schedule of Deployment of Funds

The Company has not obtained any bridge financing for the objects of the Issue. However, if the Company were to require bridge financing in the future, it would be subject to the approval of the Board of Directors and would be disclosed to the stakeholders in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations.

### Utilization of Issue Proceeds
The Company will ensure that the Issue proceeds are utilized in accordance with the objects of the Issue and in compliance with the SEBI ICDR Regulations. The Company will also ensure that the Issue proceeds are not used for any purpose other than those specified in this Draft Red Herring Prospectus.

By utilizing the Issue proceeds in the manner described above, the Company aims to achieve its strategic objectives, enhance its competitiveness, and create value for its stakeholders.

basis_for_price.title: Basis for Issue Price
basis_for_price.content:
## Basis for Issue Price

The issue price of ₹90 to ₹95 per equity share has been determined by the Company and the Lead Manager, taking into account various factors, including the Company's financials, industry trends, market conditions, and the objects of the issue.

### Qualitative Factors

The Company has considered the following qualitative factors while determining the issue price:

1. **Business Model and Industry**: Test Pharma Ltd operates in the pharmaceuticals sector, specifically in the generic drugs sub-sector. The Company has a strong presence in the domestic market and serves hospitals, distributors, and retail chemists across 10 Indian states.
2. **Growth Prospects**: The Company has a proven track record of growth, with increasing revenues and profits over the past three years. The Company's expansion plans, including the proposed expansion of manufacturing capacity at the Pune Plant, are expected to drive future growth.
3. **Management Team**: The Company is led by experienced promoters, Ramesh Kumar and Sunita Kumar, who have a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and a proven track record of managing the Company's operations.

### Quantitative Factors

The Company has considered the following quantitative factors while determining the issue price:

1. **Financial Performance**: The Company's financial performance over the past three years is as follows:
	* Revenue: ₹1,200.50 lakhs (2021-22), ₹1,480.80 lakhs (2022-23), and ₹1,820.30 lakhs (2023-24)
	* Profit After Tax (PAT): ₹85.30 lakhs (2021-22), ₹110.20 lakhs (2022-23), and ₹142.70 lakhs (2023-24)
	* Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA): ₹142.00 lakhs (2021-22), ₹178.40 lakhs (2022-23), and ₹220.50 lakhs (2023-24)
2. **Return on Equity (ROE)**: The Company's ROE for the past three years is [MISSING: ROE calculation]
3. **Price to Earnings (P/E) Ratio**: The Company's P/E ratio is [MISSING: P/E ratio calculation]
4. **Industry Comparables**: The Company's valuation multiples are comparable to those of its peers in the pharmaceutical industry, [MISSING: industry comparable data]

### Issue Price Determination

The issue price of ₹90 to ₹95 per equity share has been determined based on the above qualitative and quantitative factors. The Company believes that the issue price is fair and reasonable, considering the Company's growth prospects, financial performance, and industry trends.

### Disclosure

The Company discloses that the issue price is subject to market conditions and may be adjusted based on feedback from investors and other market participants. The Company also discloses that the issue price may not reflect the Company's true value, and investors should make their own assessment of the Company's valuation before investing in the issue.

dividend_policy.title: Dividend Policy
dividend_policy.content:
DIVIDEND POLICY

Test Pharma Ltd has not declared any dividends in the past. The Board of Directors may recommend dividends in the future, subject to the profits available for distribution, after considering the Company's growth plans, future capital requirements, financial condition, and applicable legal requirements. Any future declaration of dividends will require the approval of the shareholders of the Company at the Annual General Meeting and will be at the discretion of the Board.

There is no guarantee that dividends will be declared or paid in any financial year. Any dividends paid 
in the future will be subject to applicable laws and regulations, including Companies Act 2013, and will 
be recommended by the Board of Directors from time to time.

Investors should note that past financial performance, including past dividend payments (if any), is not 
indicative of future results.
